title: NJ Talingting
text:
I build open-source softwares to resolve the “Continental Fallacy”— the systemic bias that treats our oceans as barriers rather than conductors of connectivity in spatial modeling.
While studying Statistics in Cebu— situated beside the Philippines’ busiest maritime hub— I witnessed the gap between logistical reality and spatial data. This exposure has led me to developing tools now indexed to the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN) while handling administrative roles as appointed public official since 2023.
Beyond code, I lead and maintain PinasR, a centralized registry for local tools made by Filipino R developers to drive the open source movement in the Philippines where not everyone can afford expensive, propreitary tools. I also love reading fictional books; I pride myself in devouring some of Dan Brown’s novels in one sitting!
